decision_type: Lending decision on a borrower's application (accept/decline)
human_role: Authorised lender credit staff decide using the lender's own underwriting
appeal_route: Borrower can ask the lender for human review of a decline and use the lender's and broker's complaints processes
monitoring_metric: share of submissions declined on a criterion shown as met (wrong-lender rate)
notes: Platform shows indicative criteria matches only; it is never connected to a lender decision system

decision_type: Broker's choice of lenders to recommend to the client
human_role: Broker reviews per-rule reasons and sources and makes the recommendation
appeal_route: Broker can challenge any rule via the lender criteria contact; borrower can complain to the broker firm
monitoring_metric: broker override and agreement rates by lender and income type
notes: Broker records a shortlist view before opening AI explanations in a 10% blind sample to detect automation bias

decision_type: Indicative eligibility outcome per lender (eligible_indicative / ineligible_indicative / refer)
human_role: Broker reads per-rule reasons; refer always goes to a human
appeal_route: Broker raises a criteria challenge to the lender criteria contact (MCP-SYS-013); refer never converted to eligible by the platform
monitoring_metric: refer rate and challenge outcomes per lender
notes: Rules engine is deterministic; stale or missing data gives refer

human_role: Broker checks inputs and explains figures; lender performs its own affordability assessment
appeal_route: Broker can correct inputs and re-run; lender assessment decides
monitoring_metric: share of cases where broker corrected inputs
notes: Stress margin shown as lender policy and never as a regulatory rate

decision_type: Criteria Q&A answer to a broker question
human_role: Broker verifies the answer against the cited criteria document
notes: Answers must cite retrieved documents; decision predictions refused

human_role: Broker edits and saves the note
appeal_route: Borrower may request the broker's file under data-protection rights
monitoring_metric: share of drafts edited before save
notes: Draft never sent outside the platform by the assistant

decision_type: Lender rule publication after a criteria change
human_role: Criteria analyst prepares the change; second analyst checks
approver_role: Lender criteria contact confirms the rule
monitoring_metric: rules past 90-day re-verification; validation errors at load
